name: InverseFinance
fix_description: In latestAnswer, do not use balanceOf(CRV3CRYPTO) to calculate LP token price as pool balances can be manipulated via flash loans. Use Curve get_virtual_price() or a TWAP-based mechanism that is resistant to single-transaction manipulation.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC is a multi-step DeFi exploit involving an Aave flash loan, Curve/Yearn liquidity and vault interactions, oracle price manipulation, then borrowing from Inverse and unwinding across several pools. While it follows a known flash-loan-plus-oracle-manipulation pattern, reproducing it requires protocol-specific understanding across multiple contracts and more than a trivial exploit flow.
